narration: In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month {first_bar_apart_month}, with more of the ghost's pay committed before each month began. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. The money was furthest apart in the last month, {widest_gap_month}, when the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost started each month with less room to move, and its Freedom ended {freedom_gap}.
